entries.text: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s\nmoves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this\nmove to hit the chosen target.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_746
entries.text: This move prevents the user and the target from\nswitching out until either of them faints. The effect\ngoes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_747
entries.text: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its\nDefense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_748
entries.text: This move boosts all the user’s stats but prevents\nthe user from switching out or fleeing.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_749
entries.text: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the\ntarget’s Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to\nFire-type moves.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_750
entries.text: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes\nthe target’s type to Psychic.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_751
entries.text: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two\nopposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_752
entries.text: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in\nthe battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_753
entries.text: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing.\nThis move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def\nevery turn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_754
entries.text: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak.\nThis move’s power is doubled if the user moves\nbefore the target.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_755
entries.text: The user rends the target with its hard gills. This move’s\npower is doubled if the user moves before the target.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_756
entries.text: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on\neither side of the field.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_757
entries.text: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThe user intensifies the sun for five turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_758
entries.text: This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_759
entries.text: This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThe user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for\nfive turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_760
entries.text: This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis lowers the target’s Speed stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_761
entries.text: This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis boosts ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_762
entries.text: This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis lowers the target’s Defense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_763
entries.text: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThe user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_764
entries.text: This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis boosts ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_765
entries.text: This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThe user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_766
entries.text: This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis boosts ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_767
entries.text: This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThe user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for\nfive turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_768
entries.text: This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis lowers the target’s Attack stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_769
entries.text: This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThe user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for\nfive turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_770
entries.text: This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThe user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_771
entries.text: This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis boosts ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_772
entries.text: This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_773
entries.text: This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThe user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for\nfive turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_774
entries.text: This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.\nThis boosts ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_775
entries.text: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_776
entries.text: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target.\nThe higher the user’s Defense stat, the greater the\ndamage this move deals.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_777
entries.text: The user sharply boosts the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk\nstats by decorating the target.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_778
entries.text: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum’s roots\nto attack the target. This also lowers the target’s\nSpeed stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_779
entries.text: The user snares the target in a snap trap that inflicts\ndamage for four to five turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_780
entries.text: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching\nit as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the\ntarget with a burn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_781
entries.text: The user wields a large, powerful sword using its whole\nbody and cuts the target in a vigorous attack.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_782
entries.text: The user’s body becomes a firm shield and slams into\nthe target fiercely.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_783
entries.text: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the\nenergy stored in its cheeks. This move’s type changes\ndepending on the user’s form.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_784
entries.text: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing\nPokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_785
entries.text: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply\npointed branch.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_786
entries.text: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar\nor bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_787
entries.text: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created\nfrom tart apples. This also lowers the target’s\nSp. Def stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_788
entries.text: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from\nhigh above. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_789
entries.text: The user attacks the target with so much force that it\ncould break the target’s spirit. This also lowers the\ntarget’s Sp. Atk stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_790
entries.text: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may\nalso confuse the target.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_791
entries.text: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores\nthe HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in\nthe battle.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_792
entries.text: This move enables the user to protect itself from all\nattacks. Its chance of failing rises if used in succession.\nDirect contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_793
entries.text: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the\ntarget with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_794
entries.text: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t\nmove on the next turn, because the force of this move\nmakes it stagger.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_795
entries.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this\nmove is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t\nbe remembered.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_796
entries.text: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its\nentire body. This also damages the user.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_797
entries.text: The user attacks the target with its psychic power.\nWhen the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move’s power\nis boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_798
entries.text: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move\nfails if the ground hasn’t turned into a terrain.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_799
entries.text: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times\nin a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but\nlowers its Defense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_800
entries.text: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its\nSp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the\nnext turn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_801
entries.text: This move is either physical or special—whichever will\ninflict more damage. This may also poison the target.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_802
entries.text: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon\nusing this move. This move’s power is boosted on\nMisty Terrain.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_803
entries.text: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target.\nThis move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_804
entries.text: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground.\nThis move’s power is doubled if the target is on\nElectric Terrain.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_805
entries.text: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack.\nThis move’s type and power change depending on\nthe terrain at the time the move is used.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_806
entries.text: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also\nlowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_807
entries.text: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves\nall opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted\nduring the turn with a burn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_808
entries.text: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the\ntarget. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s stats\nwere lowered during this turn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_809
entries.text: The user attacks by controlling the target’s item.\nThis move fails if the target isn’t holding an item.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_810
entries.text: The user surrounds everything around it with highly\nacidic gas and melts away items held by other Pokémon.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_811
entries.text: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting\ntheir Attack and Defense stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_812
entries.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch\nplaces with a party Pokémon in waiting.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_813
entries.text: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more\npowerful with each successful hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_814
entries.text: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage.\nThe target is hit twice in a row.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_815
entries.text: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack.\nThis may also leave the target with a burn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_816
entries.text: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and\ncuring status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon\ncurrently in the battle.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_817
entries.text: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the\ntarget with a fierce blow. This move always lands\na critical hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_818
entries.text: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the\ntarget with a flowing motion three times in a row. This\nmove always lands a critical hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_819
entries.text: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking\nelectricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_820
entries.text: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks\nopposing Pokémon. The lower the user’s HP, the lower\nthe move’s power.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_821
entries.text: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack.\nThis may also leave the target frozen.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_822
entries.text: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to\nattack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_823
entries.text: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like\nmovement before delivering a kick. This also lowers\nthe target’s Defense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_824
entries.text: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle\nlance at opposing Pokémon.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_825
entries.text: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small\nghosts at opposing Pokémon.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_826
entries.text: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power.\nThis also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the\ntarget.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_827
entries.text: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws.\nThis may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or\nasleep.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_828
entries.text: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into\nthe target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_829
entries.text: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_830
entries.text: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone\nsplinters left behind by this attack float around the\ntarget.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_831
entries.text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in\nfierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also\nlower their Attack stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_832
entries.text: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power.\nThis also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_833
entries.text: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to\nthree turns. The user then becomes confused.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_834
entries.text: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target\nwith its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages\nthe user quite a lot.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_835
entries.text: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict\ndamage on the target. This also damages the user.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_836
entries.text: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict\ndamage. This may also make the target flinch.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_837
entries.text: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory,\nboosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_838
entries.text: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle.\nThis also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_839
entries.text: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict\ndamage. This may also poison the target. This move’s\npower is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_840
entries.text: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings.\nThis also boosts the user’s Speed stat. This move has\na heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_841
entries.text: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment.\nThis also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_842
entries.text: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply\nboosting its Defense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_843
entries.text: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a\nheightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also\nlower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_844
entries.text: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also\nleave the target with a burn. This move’s power is\ndoubled if the target has a status condition.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_845
entries.text: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell\nsplinters left behind by this attack remain scattered\nunder the target as spikes.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_846
entries.text: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause\nboth body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the\nSpeed stats of opposing Pokémon.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_847
entries.text: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely\nattacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave\nopposing Pokémon with paralysis.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_848
entries.text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in\nfierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave\nthem with a burn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_849
entries.text: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon,\nrestoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and\nits ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_850
entries.text: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions\nand boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_851
entries.text: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its\nTera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or\nSp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_851_01
entries.text: Inflicts damage with the user’s Attack or Sp. Atk stat—\nwhichever is higher. Super effective against Terastallized\ntargets. This lowers the user’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_852
entries.text: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from\ndamage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker\nthat makes direct contact.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_853
entries.text: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming\nits heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the\ntarget. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_854
entries.text: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated\nallies there are in the user’s party, the greater the move’s\npower.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_855
entries.text: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even\naffects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target’s\nSp. Def stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_856
entries.text: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a\nTatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user’s\nstats based on the Tatsugiri’s form.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_857
entries.text: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches\nat blinding speed. This move always goes first.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_858
entries.text: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply\nboosting the target’s Attack stat and harshly lowering\nthe target’s Defense stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_859
entries.text: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting\ndamage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user’s\nSpeed stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_860
entries.text: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo\nattack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_861
entries.text: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around,\nslamming into the target. This move’s spinning motion\nalso destroys the terrain.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_862
entries.text: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge.\nAfter this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss\nand will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_863
entries.text: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party\nPokémon that has fainted and restoring half that\nPokémon’s max HP.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_864
entries.text: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every\nturn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected\nby this move.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_865
entries.text: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting\nthe target with splashes of water three times in a row.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_866
entries.text: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate\nthe effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech\nSeed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_867
entries.text: The user captures the very essence of the target in a\nsketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally\nPokémon to that of the target.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_868
entries.text: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed\nstats by using its own HP.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_869
entries.text: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make\nthe target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_870
entries.text: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the\ntarget. This attack never misses and always lands a\ncritical hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_871
entries.text: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song,\nscorching the target. This also boosts the user’s\nSp. Atk stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_872
entries.text: The user toys with the target and attacks it using\nlight and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the\nuser’s Speed stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_873
entries.text: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move’s\ntype depends on the user’s form. It can also break\nbarriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_874
entries.text: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This\nalso lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after\nthe battle.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_875
entries.text: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This\nmove’s power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on\nElectric Terrain.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_876
entries.text: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This\nmove’s power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather\nboosted by 50 percent.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_877
entries.text: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the\ntarget’s HP in half.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_878
entries.text: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing\na massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is\nboosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_879
entries.text: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its\ntarget with futuristic electricity. This move’s power is\nboosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_880
entries.text: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP\nbefore switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_881
entries.text: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching\nplaces with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a\nsnowstorm lasting five turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_882
entries.text: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes,\nStealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute.\nThis also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_883
entries.text: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.\nThis boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_884
entries.text: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also\nlowers the target’s Speed stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_885
entries.text: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall\ngrass. The user’s nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_886
entries.text: The user attacks the target by showering it with water\nthat’s so cold it saps the target’s power. This also lowers\nthe target’s Attack stat.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_887
entries.text: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed\nto pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a\nmove such as Protect or Detect.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_888
entries.text: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict\ndamage. The target is hit twice in a row.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_889
entries.text: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The\nmore times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater\nthe move’s power.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_890
entries.text: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles.\nThis also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_891
entries.text: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of\nthe living into a slashing attack. The user’s HP is restored\nby up to half the damage taken by the target.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_892
entries.text: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to\nperform a high-damage attack. After using this move,\nthe user will no longer be Electric type.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_893
entries.text: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its\nhuge hammer. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_894
entries.text: The user retaliates with much greater force against\nthe opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_895
entries.text: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like\na blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a\ncritical hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_901
entries.text: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full\nmoon that shines as red as blood. This move can’t be\nused twice in a row.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_902
entries.text: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user’s HP\nis restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.\nThis may also leave the target with a burn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_903
entries.text: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup,\nwhich coats the target and causes the target’s Speed\nstat to drop each turn for three turns.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_904
entries.text: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move’s\ntype changes depending on the mask worn by the user,\nand it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_905
entries.text: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its\nSp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next\nturn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_906
entries.text: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and\neliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its\nStellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_907
entries.text: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage.\nSometimes all the user’s heads shoot beams in unison,\ndoubling the move’s power.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_908
entries.text: The user’s intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and\nalso burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_909
entries.text: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of\nelectricity. This move fails if the target is not readying\nan attack.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_910
entries.text: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its\nhead to cleave the target. This move hits even if the\ntarget protects itself.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_911
entries.text: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the\ntarget twice in a row. This attack never misses.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_912
entries.text: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to\ninflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the\ngreater the move’s power.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_913
entries.text: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so\nthat their future attacks have a heightened chance of\nlanding critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_914
entries.text: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice.\nThis also confuses the target if its stats have been\nboosted during the turn.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_915
entries.text: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target.\nThis move’s power is doubled if the user’s previous\nmove failed.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_916
entries.text: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target\nto inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes\ndamage instead.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_917
entries.text: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves.\nFor two turns, the target is prevented from recovering\nHP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_918
entries.text: The user reacts to the target’s movement and strikes\nwith the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This\nmove fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

entries.label: WAZAINFO_919
entries.text: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them\nin a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target\nbadly poisoned.
